# Parvati, daughter of Himavan

`d-himavan` | Ambal, Parvati, Durga and Kali | 19 songs

Parvati (Imayavalli, Umadevi) is the daughter of Himavan, the Mountain-King, born as a boon after his penance. The songs use this as the Devi's identity before saying she gave birth to Murugan.
